picks.title: deadmau5's AUTO/PILOT Just Landed in Public Beta: A New Power Tool for DJs and Live Performers?
picks.excerpt: deadmau5 has pushed his AUTO/PILOT DJ and live-performance platform into public beta, pitching an assisted, stem-aware performance rig rather than a conventional deck layout. It puts an artist-built AI performance tool in front of working DJs for the first time.
picks.rationale: An artist-built AI performance rig anyone can actually load today — public beta, stem-aware, and it rethinks the deck layout rather than bolting AI onto it.

picks.title: Watch out, Suno: Google upgrades Lyria AI with 'more realistic vocals'
picks.excerpt: Google DeepMind's upgraded Lyria model rolls out inside Flow Music with structural awareness of verse/chorus/bridge, more expressive vocals and finer tempo and duration control. The vocal and arrangement gains are the part that changes what creators can actually use.
picks.rationale: The biggest capability jump in generative music this cycle — verse/chorus structure control and usable vocals move Lyria from demo toy toward session material.

picks.title: Good News! Spotify Removed 75 Million AI-Generated Slop Music Tracks
picks.excerpt: Spotify's new filter has stripped 75 million fully AI-generated, impersonation and mass-upload tracks that were siphoning royalties. It sets a de facto quality line that creators uploading AI-assisted work now have to stay on the right side of.
picks.rationale: Distribution-side enforcement at scale: 75M takedowns draw the practical line every uploader using AI-assisted tools now has to stay on.

picks.title: I tested 9 of the best stem separation tools. Here's how they compare
picks.excerpt: MusicTech runs nine AI stem separation tools through the same material to compare artefacts, speed and DAW integration. A practical map of which unmixing model to trust for remix, sampling and live work.
picks.rationale: A same-material head-to-head of nine unmixing models — the rare piece that settles a tool choice for remix, sampling and live sets tomorrow morning.

picks.title: Beatbox your ideas into reality with Vochlea's DubBox, an app that converts your voice into drum loops
picks.excerpt: Vochlea's DubBox listens to beatboxing and turns it into a finished drum loop, using voice as the input device instead of pads or a grid. It is a small but concrete shift in how an idea gets from a producer's head into a session.
picks.rationale: Voice as the input device instead of pads or a grid — a shipped app that shortens the path from a hummed idea to a usable drum part.
